name: pairpilot
description: Human-controlled AI pair programming. The AI proposes, you review and approve, then PairPilot writes the code in your real editor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: PairPilot runs the Claude Code CLI with file access, so it requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: PairPilot writes files through the local file system.

commands.title: PairPilot: Set or Replace Provider API Key…
PairPilot: Disconnect Provider and Delete Stored Key…

pairpilot.runtime.claudePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Claude Code CLI executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (`claude` on `PATH`, then common install locations).

pairpilot.runtime.useBareMode.markdownDescription: Run the CLI with `--bare`, which skips built-in prompt scaffolding, tool definitions and `CLAUDE.md` auto-discovery. Substantially reduces input tokens per call. Disable only if you rely on custom `CLAUDE.md` context.

pairpilot.runtime.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for a single AI turn before the process is terminated.

pairpilot.runtime.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments passed to the Claude Code CLI. Arguments that would re-enable file-writing tools or bypass permissions are rejected for safety.

pairpilot.context.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of workspace files included in a single AI request.

pairpilot.context.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum size in bytes for a single file included as context. Larger files are truncated.

pairpilot.context.maxTotalChars.description: Maximum total number of characters of file content included in a single AI request.

pairpilot.context.treeDepth.description: Depth of the workspace tree summary included in the request.

pairpilot.context.includeTree.description: Include a shallow workspace tree summary in AI requests. No file contents are included by this option.

pairpilot.safety.requireSensitiveFileApp.description: Show a modal confirmation before any sensitive file (for example `.env`, `.npmrc`, credential files) is read as context or written.

pairpilot.safety.allowSensitiveFileConte.description: Allow sensitive files to be offered as context at all. Even when enabled, each file still requires explicit per-file approval. Private keys and `.git` internals are always blocked.

pairpilot.advisor.enabled.description: After an approval, analyze the code and recommend exactly one next engineering step.

pairpilot.advisor.useAI.description: Use the AI runtime for the next-step recommendation. When disabled, PairPilot uses its local dependency analysis only.

pairpilot.session.maxHistory.description: Maximum number of sessions kept in local workspace storage.

enumDescriptions: Use the locally installed Claude Code CLI. No API key is stored by PairPilot and no request leaves your machine beyond the CLI's own.
Use a remote OpenAI-compatible provider. Requires an API key, which is kept in VS Code's encrypted secret storage.
pairpilot.providers.activeProvider.markdownDescription: Which AI backend serves PairPilot's requests. PairPilot ships with the local Claude Code CLI enabled by default; switching to a remote provider is a deliberate choice and PairPilot will not make it for you.

pairpilot.providers.openrouter.enabled.description: Offer OpenRouter as a selectable provider in the "AI Providers & Models" view. Switching it off refuses turns that would go to OpenRouter and marks the provider card as switched off; the card stays listed, a stored key is kept rather than deleted, and the model catalogue keeps refreshing because it is a public endpoint that needs no key.

pairpilot.providers.openrouter.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the OpenRouter API. Change this only to point at a compatible gateway you control; the API key stored for this provider is sent to whatever host is configured here.

pairpilot.providers.openrouter.maxOutput.markdownDescription: Cap on output tokens per request. `0` sends no cap and lets the model's own default apply. A model that spends its whole output budget on reasoning returns no text at all, so a cap that is too low can look like an empty reply.

pairpilot.providers.catalogRefreshHours.markdownDescription: How long a fetched model catalogue is considered fresh, in hours. The catalogue is refreshed when the management view opens and the cached copy is older than this. `0` turns automatic refreshing off: the catalogue is then fetched only when you run "PairPilot: Refresh Model Catalog".

pairpilot.cost.budgetUsd.markdownDescription: Advisory spend warning, in US dollars, per session. When a session's recorded cost passes this figure PairPilot shows a warning once. `0` disables the warning. **PairPilot never blocks a request on cost**, whatever this is set to.

pairpilot.cost.historyLimit.description: Maximum number of usage records kept in local storage. The oldest records are discarded first.
